# Walkthroughs — Vars

Var definitions are derived from `module.lowdefy.yaml`. Pass these via the `vars:` block in your app's `lowdefy.yaml` entry for this module.

## Summary

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `collection` | string | `walkthroughs` |  | MongoDB collection holding walkthroughs. |
| `region` | string |  | Yes | AWS region of the screenshot bucket (e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1). Only used to compose the object URL, so a wrong one fails at image load rather than at build — which is why it has no default. |
| `frame_width` | number | `860` |  | Width of the player's viewport in pixels. The zoom rule is calibrated against it, so a consumer changing it should re-check that highlights stay inside the frame. |
| `frame_height` | number | `520` |  | Height of the player's viewport in pixels. |
| `writable` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether this app may author walkthroughs. False keeps the module read-only: the collection and the screenshot bucket both refuse writes, and every authoring endpoint refuses outright. |
